newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen higher at open.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen higher at open.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were expected to open higher Tuesday following a three-day U.S. holiday with investors focusing on a handful of merger deals announced this morning.
Analysts said the mergers would not only dominate special situations and affect those stocks involved, but generate momentum for the overall market as well.
"Mergers are supportive of the market. They build momentum as investors search out other opportunities," said Peter Cardillo, director of research at Westfalia Investments.
